newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms seek 2.8 trln won July bond issues.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms seek 2.8 trln won July bond issues.

text.p: Applications for South Korean corporate bond issues in July totalled 2.82 trillion won, against 2.85 trillion won in June, the Korea Securities Dealers Association said on Tuesday.
All applications will be approved, it said. In June, 98 percent of applications were issued.
Of the total, applications for convertible bonds were 159 billion won, compared with 43 billion won in June, the association said.
